sources.title: vLLM DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe (deployment authority, AMD verification refusal, MTP-module drop)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Maintainer recipe authority: vLLM 0.30.0+ floor (Docker only, no pip wheel; main PR #56228, nightly from 2026-09-10); 552B backbone + 196.6B Engram; 8B-prefill/16B-decode CED; two-tier sparse attention (128-token SWA + indexer-selected 512, only layers 2/8/14/20 compress); MXFP4 experts / MXFP8 dense / BF16 embeddings.
claims.context: Recipe page fully consumed this pass (recipes.vllm.ai, updated 2026-09-20).

claims.text: DSpark is the only speculative method (5-token blocks, Markov bias + confidence heads, ~14B drafter); V4.1 dropped the MTP module. On AMD, vLLM refuses adaptive verification (two failed checks: CPU-query-lens mismatch unsupported, ROCm backend UNIFORM_BATCH); the recipe pins enable_adaptive_verification:false with full-block verification.
claims.context: DSpark/MTP distinction and AMD conditions per recipe; do not generalize to other stacks.

claims.text: Reasoning effort is numeric 1-100 (low25/high50/xhigh75/max100 in vLLM mapping vs API 50/75/100); default-on at effort 50 with small max_tokens reads as breakage (empty content, finish_reason=length) — a deployment-behavior fact.
claims.context: Effort semantics + failure-mode documentation per recipe.

claims.text: Verified layouts: 1P1D disaggregation on GB200 NVL4 (TP4 pools, NIXL KV handoff, max-num-seqs 32); TP2+Engram-CPU-offload on Blackwell/H200/MI355X with per-SKU overrides; FlashInfer autotune/JIT/CuTeDSL and DeepGEMM warmup disabled; KV offload validated on 4xH200 (TieringOffloadingSpec, GSM8K 31/32 diagnostic, small-sample).
claims.context: Layout facts with validation scope; benchmark config (InferenceX #3058, golden acceptance 3.51) is pinned-config evidence only.

limitations.text: Recipe is living documentation (nightly drift); pinned-config validation does not transfer to other images or scheduler caps.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Throughput-mode synthetic acceptance is measurement-only; EVAL_ONLY=true (real rejection) governs serving.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
